subject: Request: executive greenlight (25% Hosted API) for Pulsebridge Therapeutics
body:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: executive greenlight (25% Hosted API) for Pulsebridge Therapeutics

Team —

As discussed in the pipeline review, Pulsebridge (machine-assisted clinical workflows for cardiology) is asking for a 25% off list Hosted API rate on a 36-month committed usage contract. I’m requesting executive clearance to offer >20% (specifically 25%) due to the following commercial rationale:

- Strategic reference: Pulsebridge is committed to a co-marketing program and will participate in an enterprise case study if we land the three-region rollout.
- Committed spend: they expect to ramp to ~$180k/month net after discount by month 9 (projected ARR ~$1.6M over 36 months).
- Marketplace and channel: Pulsebridge will onboard via the cloud marketplace and listed as an early reference for our cardiology vertical (helps GTM).
- Migration lift: they will contribute an implementation services retainer (~$120k) to cover migration and compliance work.

Attached: commercial terms draft, SOW v3, and a quick unit economics sheet the customer provided.

Request: executive greenlight to authorize a 25% hosted-usage discount (one-time rate amendment) subject to: legal signoff on DPA, SOC2 evidence verification, and a minimum 36-month commitment with a 12-month non-cancelable baseline.

Why this is time-sensitive: Pulsebridge is evaluating two alternatives; they requested a decision by next Friday (06/30) to hit their product launch window. Ben, Laura — I’m looping you for margin and finance validation. Rishi — if you want this escalated to the executive queue for sign-off, please advise.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: Pulsebridge_Commercial_Terms.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: Pulsebridge_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: PB_unit_economics.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: executive greenlight (25% Hosted API) for Pulsebridge Therapeutics

+1 from me. Customer is strategically small but will give strong vertical signal. Mateo — can you confirm the committed-minimum baseline number (12-month non-cancelable) and the proposed billing cadence? Finance — need confirmation that the economics hit is acceptable at 25%.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

On Fri, 21 Jun 2028 at 10:45, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

> Mateo / Ben —
>
> Thanks for the context. I ran a quick back-of-envelope with the PB_unit_economics.xlsx you attached. At 25% off list pricing the first-year gross margin on Hosted usage looks tight (~18% gross margin) until they ramp in Q4.
>
> Two asks before I can recommend executive approval:
> 1) Confirm the minimum monthly committed spend that is guaranteed in year 1 (you mentioned a 12-month non-cancelable baseline — please provide the $ number).
> 2) Add a churn/step-down clause after year 1 if actual usage deviates >30% of forecast (protects us if they underutilize).
>
> If both are in the commercial terms we can sign off operationally; final financial approval requires Rishi (or exec) to greenlight the margin concession.
>
> —Laura
> Finance Lead, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

On Fri, 21 Jun 2028 at 15:00, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

> Laura / Ben / Rishi —
>
> Following up with the numbers you requested. Summary:
> - 12-month non-cancelable baseline: $45,000/mo minimum in year 1 (billed monthly).
> - Ramp plan: month 1 $60k (post-discount expected consumption), month 9 $180k.
> - Break-fix protections: customer committed to a $120k implementation retainer + a quarterly usage review cadence.
> - Churn protection: proposed contract language includes a step-down clause (if usage <70% of forecast for two consecutive quarters, pricing reverts to list rates subject to true-up).
>
> Pulsebridge legal signaled they accept the step-down language; I’ve attached the marked-up commercial terms. They explicitly want a 25% off list rate to justify their budget to their board.
>
> I recommend we proceed with executive greenlight given the reference + marketplace benefits and the guaranteed baseline. If finance still sees a problem at 25%, I can try to push for a 22% offer but that reduces the closability argument.
>
> Best,
> Mateo

> [Quoted attachments referenced above]

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: executive greenlight (25% Hosted API) for Pulsebridge Therapeutics

Thanks for the synopsis. Mateo — I support proceeding to exec for a single-instance concession given the strategic GTM upside and the multi-year commitment. Laura — your requests (baseline $45k and step-down clause) should be codified in the amendment; legal to review.

I’m escalating to Markus for final clearance because this exceeds our standard approval thresholds (>20%). Copying along the ask and the docs.

Rishi
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: executive greenlight (25% Hosted API) for Pulsebridge Therapeutics

I reviewed the deal pack. Conditions for my sign-off:
1) Final DPA executed with SOC2 attachments on file.
2) 12-month minimum baseline of $45k/mo explicitly in the amendment.
3) Step-down clause as drafted in the commercial terms (usage <70% triggers true-up).
4) Legal to prepare a 36-month amendment with the 25% concession and an exit true-up schedule.

Assuming legal confirms the DPA/SOC2 items and the amendment language is correct, I authorize this single-instance 25% hosted-usage discount for Pulsebridge for a 36-month commitment. Please proceed to get signatures and update HubSpot deal status to "Authorized - Exec".

Markus Klein
Chief Revenue Officer (interim) | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

---

From: Ari Patel <ari.patel@pulsebridge.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jessica Moore <jessica.moore@pulsebridge.ai>, procurement@pulsebridge.ai
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2028 12:45:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood hosted pricing

Mateo — incredible, thank you. We’ll start our procurement review immediately and aim to return a signed amendment within two weeks once legal confirms the DPA text. We appreciate the flexibility — this partnership matters for our launch roadmap.

Best,
Ari
Head of Platform & Partnerships | Pulsebridge Therapeutics
